507	/-- Let `F` be a sheaf valued in a concrete category, whose forgetful functor reflects isomorphisms,
508	preserves limits and filtered colimits. Then two sections who agree on every stalk must be equal.
509	-/
510	theorem section_ext (F : Sheaf C X) (U : Opens X) (s t : ToType (F.1.obj (op U)))
511	    (h : ∀ (x : X) (hx : x ∈ U), F.presheaf.germ U x hx s = F.presheaf.germ U x hx t) : s = t := by
512	  -- We use `germ_eq` and the axiom of choice, to pick for every point `x` a neighbourhood
513	  -- `V x`, such that the restrictions of `s` and `t` to `V x` coincide.
514	  choose V m i₁ i₂ heq using fun x : U => F.presheaf.germ_eq x.1 x.2 x.2 s t (h x.1 x.2)
515	  -- Since `F` is a sheaf, we can prove the equality locally, if we can show that these
516	  -- neighborhoods form a cover of `U`.
517	  apply F.eq_of_locally_eq' V U i₁
518	  · intro x hxU
519	    simp only [Opens.mem_iSup]
520	    exact ⟨⟨x, hxU⟩, m ⟨x, hxU⟩⟩
521	  · intro x
522	    rw [heq, Subsingleton.elim (i₁ x) (i₂ x)]

575	/-- For surjectivity, we are given an arbitrary section `t` and need to find a preimage for it.
576	We claim that it suffices to find preimages *locally*. That is, for each `x : U` we construct
577	a neighborhood `V ≤ U` and a section `s : F.obj (op V))` such that `f.app (op V) s` and `t`
578	agree on `V`. -/
579	theorem app_surjective_of_injective_of_locally_surjective {F G : Sheaf C X} (f : F ⟶ G)
580	    (U : Opens X) (hinj : ∀ x ∈ U, Function.Injective ((stalkFunctor C x).map f.1))
581	    (hsurj : ∀ (t x) (_ : x ∈ U), ∃ (V : Opens X) (_ : x ∈ V) (iVU : V ⟶ U)
582	    (s : ToType (F.1.obj (op V))), f.1.app (op V) s = G.1.map iVU.op t) :
583	    Function.Surjective (f.1.app (op U)) := by
584	  conv at hsurj =>
585	    enter [t]
586	    rw [Subtype.forall' (p := (· ∈ U))]
587	  intro t
588	  -- We use the axiom of choice to pick around each point `x` an open neighborhood `V` and a
589	  -- preimage under `f` on `V`.
590	  choose V mV iVU sf heq using hsurj t
591	  -- These neighborhoods clearly cover all of `U`.
592	  have V_cover : U ≤ iSup V := by
593	    intro x hxU
594	    simp only [Opens.mem_iSup]
595	    exact ⟨⟨x, hxU⟩, mV ⟨x, hxU⟩⟩
596	  suffices IsCompatible F.obj V sf by
597	    -- Since `F` is a sheaf, we can glue all the local preimages together to get a global preimage.
598	    obtain ⟨s, s_spec, -⟩ := F.existsUnique_gluing' V U iVU V_cover sf this
599	    · use s
600	      apply G.eq_of_locally_eq' V U iVU V_cover
601	      intro x
602	      rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← f.1.naturality, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, s_spec, heq]
603	  intro x y
604	  -- What's left to show here is that the sections `sf` are compatible, i.e. they agree on
605	  -- the intersections `V x ⊓ V y`. We prove this by showing that all germs are equal.
606	  apply section_ext
607	  intro z hz
608	  -- Here, we need to use injectivity of the stalk maps.
609	  apply hinj z ((iVU x).le ((inf_le_left : V x ⊓ V y ≤ V x) hz))
610	  rw [stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply, stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply]
611	  simp_rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, f.1.naturality, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, heq,
612	    ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← G.1.map_comp]
613	  rfl

623	  obtain ⟨V₁, hxV₁, s₁, rfl⟩ := F.presheaf.exists_germ_eq s₀

629	  -- The restriction of `s₁` to that neighborhood is our desired local preimage.
630	  use V₂, hxV₂, iV₂U, F.1.map iV₂V₁.op s₁
631	  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, f.1.naturality, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, heq]
